the_ruling_verbatim: this should cover a few things: anything settled by measurment trumps approvals by even me.
My own commits... since we're trying to bring everything into alignment with my head, my head trumps everything except measurments.
now_the_spec_says: Authority order: measurement > Akien's head > every artifact, his commits included. Measurement-settled queues for nobody's approval, his included — only a re-measurement moves it. His head outranks every translation; his past commits carry the corrosion predicate.
the_reason_that_dies: No file dies — a queueing habit dies: routing measurement-settled items to Akien's gate for ratification. The 2026-08-15 curated review framed retirements, the runtime-spine clear, and verified-green tickets as 'your review is the ratification'; under this ruling the ones settled by measurement stand on the measurement, and only the interpretation-bearing items queue. The habit felt like deference; it was spending his resolver on the settled (Law 1).
context: The two top ranks govern different questions and compose rather than collide: a measurement says what IS; his head says what SHOULD BE. An approval cannot override a measured fact. His own past commits are translations like any other artifact — drift in one of his commits with no ruling in the same act is still corrosion, and his live word supersedes his recorded one. What stays at his gate is exactly what only his head can settle: translation fidelity (is CC's reading of his words right?), spec choices, and any CC interpretation standing in for a measurement — a CC 'read of the record' is artifact-rank material and always queues for him. Spoken 2026-08-15, replying to the Fable sweep report (57 tickets swept, 134 findings curated to 17, runtime-spine trouble cleared on live measurement). His words aim at the parked questions ('this should cover a few things'): finding 355143331fff had parked 'are his own commits subject to the corrosion predicate?' — answered: yes, they are artifacts below his head; and the review's ratification framing — answered: measurement-settled items do not wait on him. Boundary this ruling does NOT move: the ruling door's confirm step and the recordverdict gate remain his, because they check translation fidelity and interpretation — head-rank questions a measurement cannot answer. Owed under this ruling, not yet ticketed: the ruling door stamps confirmed only from his marker even where every conformer is hash-verified — a measurement-settled ruling still queues for approval, which this ruling now names as the wrong default.
